dedupe_keys.name: deutscher feuerwehrverband statistics numbers of german fire brigades members and operations by type national totals

description: These figures are the only national summary of Germany's fire services, a system built largely on volunteers, giving the number of brigades, their members and the operations they carry out each year. They are compiled by the Deutscher Feuerwehrverband, the national fire brigades association, from returns that the state interior ministries collect under the FEU 905 reporting scheme, together with youth brigade, accident insurance and federal statistics. The latest reference year is 2023: about 23,800 volunteer and 114 professional brigades, 728 works brigades and nearly 1.46 million members, with operations split into fires and explosions, technical assistance, disaster alarms, false alarms, emergency ambulance rescue and patient transport, and the number of fire deaths. The figures are available free on the statistics page, with a PDF overview of their development over time to download; the full series used to appear in a paid yearbook. Caveats: only national totals are published, state reporting practices differ, and the update lags about two years. Simulation uses: setting the scale and mix of fire service demand and volunteer resources for national emergency service and civil protection capacity models. Related records: CTIF world fire statistics (data-ctif-world-fire-statistics) compares Germany with other countries, and the Scottish fire statistics (data-sfrs-fire-stations-and-incident-statistics) show station-level detail elsewhere.

schema_summary: National totals: volunteer, professional, youth and works fire brigades; members by brigade type and number of women; operations by field (fires and explosions, disaster alarms, technical assistance, animals and insects, other, false alarms, ambulance emergency rescue, patient transport); fire deaths; statistical development over time in a PDF overview

sources.note: DFV compiles statistics from the state interior ministries (collection under FEU 905), the German youth fire brigade, accident insurers and the Federal Statistical Office; published until 2025 in the Feuerwehr-Jahrbuch; next update end of 2026. At 31 December 2023: 23,760 volunteer fire brigades, 114 professional brigades, 24,254 youth brigades, 728 works brigades; 1,028,021 active volunteer members, 39,501 professional, 1,458,560 members in total. Operations 2023: 286,622 fires and explosions, 139 disaster alarms, 797,626 technical assistance, 376,643 false alarms, 2,450,080 ambulance emergency rescue, 367,346 patient transport; 329 deaths from smoke, fire and flames (Federal Statistical Office); link to the statistical development overview PDF and to CTIF world statistics
